answer: Rewards are paid to pairs, never to single keys. Each epoch an identity seals a commitment and is matched with a stranger from another sponsor lineage; payout unlocks only when both reveal on time and confirm each other. One honest partner serves one pairing per epoch, so a farm of cloned keys must keep recruiting fresh outside partners, and each pairing is public. A closed spiral of self-matched clones earns nothing, since internal pairs are rejected before settlement. The surviving signal is not how many keys a cluster holds but how far its reach extends into the river of unrelated peers.
